t: What Quantum Experiment Database Is All About
title: What Quantum Experiment Database Is All About
description: Quantum experiments test reality's strangest rules: superposition, entanglement, uncertainty. The double-slit experiment shows particles interfering like waves; Bell tests (Nobel 2022) proved entanglement is real and local realism is false; the quantum Hall effect measures resistance in exact fractions of h/e². Each experiment here carries its setup, outcome, and what it ruled out. This database is the complete quantum experiment: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.

t: Core Vocabulary of Quantum Experiment Database
title: Core Vocabulary of Quantum Experiment Database
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Quantum Experiment Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: superposition: quantum system in multiple states at once until measured; entanglement: correlations stronger than any local theory allows; decoherence: environment destroying quantum behavior; qubit: two-state quantum system.
definition: The working vocabulary of Quantum Experiment Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: superposition: quantum system in multiple states at once until measured
entanglement: correlations stronger than any local theory allows
decoherence: environment destroying quantum behavior
qubit: two-state quantum system
Bell inequality: statistical limit obeyed by local realistic theories
wavefunction collapse: the measurement problem's central puzzle

Use three terms in a sentence of your own.
